evals.name: greenfield-opening
evals.prompt: I want to start planning a new side project: a CLI tool called shelfwise that tracks my homelab server inventory — hardware specs, what services run where, warranty dates, that kind of thing. Let's plan this product.
evals.expected_output: Conversational opening, not a document dump: a short orientation (acknowledges greenfield), frames the fork-level questions, and ends by asking exactly ONE decision question with options, trade-offs, and a recommendation. Does NOT generate a full PRD unprompted, does NOT ask a battery of questions.
files: empty git repo as working directory
assertions: asks-exactly-one-decision-question: the reply poses exactly one decision-level question to the user (rhetorical/quoted questions excluded) — not a battery of questions, not zero
no-unprompted-prd-dump: neither the reply nor the repo contains a full multi-section PRD document; the reply is conversational framing, not a finished spec
options-plus-recommendation: the single question is presented with 2+ options, their trade-offs, and an explicit recommendation
orients-before-asking: the reply acknowledges the starting state (greenfield/empty repo) before asking anything

evals.name: draft-feature-prd-artifacts
evals.prompt: Let's plan a new feature for taskpilot: recurring tasks (daily/weekly schedules, with skip and pause). I've already made these calls: schedules are stored as RRULE strings on the task; occurrences are generated lazily when the app runs (no background jobs); lookahead is capped at 1 year. Use whatever doc structure you think is best and go ahead and draft the feature PRD now — don't wait for me.
evals.expected_output: Creates a namespaced planning space (docs/better-planning/...) without clobbering the existing docs/plans/old-roadmap.md; feature PRD at product/features/recurring-tasks/recurring-tasks-prd.md (stem-named) with status header, contracts, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and a decisions table containing the three given decisions; a self-contained companion recurring-tasks-prd-overview.html ending with a 'things to poke at' section; GLOSSARY.md and README.md map created/updated.
files: fixtures/taskpilot — small CLI app with legacy docs/plans/old-roadmap.md
assertions: namespaced-stem-named-prd: a feature PRD exists at docs/better-planning/product/features/recurring-tasks/recurring-tasks-prd.md (namespaced layout, stem-named file)

companion-html-self-contained-with-poke-at: a companion *-prd-overview.html exists next to the PRD, contains no external http(s) resource references (self-contained), and ends with an open-questions / things-to-poke-at section
decisions-table-captures-user-calls: the PRD contains a decisions table including all three user-given decisions (RRULE storage, lazy on-run generation, 1-year lookahead cap)
legacy-docs-untouched: docs/plans/old-roadmap.md is byte-identical to the fixture version
glossary-and-map-exist: docs/better-planning/GLOSSARY.md and docs/better-planning/README.md (with a status index) both exist
prd-structure-complete: the PRD has a status header (Status/Depends/Companion) plus acceptance criteria and edge cases sections

evals.name: resume-existing-space
evals.prompt: Pick up the planning work in this repo — give me the state of things and let's figure out what to do next.
evals.expected_output: Reads docs/better-planning/README.md index and doc headers; presents a digest of state (PRD settled, pantry-sync in-review with one open question, shopping-list-gen next per roadmap); does NOT re-ask settled decisions (platform, recipe source, manual entry); recommends a concrete next step (resolve pantry-sync's barcode question and/or start shopping-list-gen PRD) and ends with at most one question.
files: fixtures/mealmate — repo with an existing docs/better-planning/ space mid-flight
assertions: digest-reflects-actual-state: the reply's digest mentions the settled PRD, pantry-sync being in-review, AND its open barcode-scanning question
no-relitigating-settled-decisions: none of the already-settled decisions (PWA platform, user-entered recipes, manual pantry entry) are re-asked as questions
concrete-next-step-recommended: the reply recommends a specific next action (resolve the barcode question and/or start the shopping-list-gen PRD), with reasoning
at-most-one-question: the reply ends with at most one question to the user
fixture-docs-unmodified: no files in docs/better-planning/ were modified (git status clean)
